name: How much does bathroom trim installation typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does bathroom trim installation typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install bathroom trim varies based on room dimensions, trim style, material type, and the complexity of the cuts. Standard PVC or moisture-resistant baseboard installation generally costs less in material and labor than high-end custom wood crown molding or decorative wainscoting. Key factors that influence the overall estimate include the linear footage required, any necessary demolition or disposal of rotted materials, and whether you want pre-finished materials or full on-site painting and caulking. Combining trim work with a broader bathroom remodel can also optimize overall labor costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on linear footage, material choice like PVC versus custom wood, and finishing needs like caulking and painting.
